title: GTA 6 Blinkit Delivery Goes Live in 11 Indian Cities
description: GTA 6 Blinkit delivery has started in 11 Indian cities, with the PS5 Standard Edition code priced at ₹5,999, according to Inc42. Here is what to know.

body.text: GTA 6 Blinkit delivery is now live: according to Inc42, the quick commerce platform has started delivering boxed download codes for the PS5 edition of Grand Theft Auto VI in select areas of 11 Indian cities. It matters because it puts one of the biggest game launches ever into a 10-minute delivery app, and gives PS5 owners a way to pre-load the game before it unlocks.
Blinkit CEO Albinder Dhindsa announced the rollout, per Inc42. What arrives is not a traditional disc. Customers get a physical box with a digital download code inside.
The steps, as described in the report:

items: Order the PS5 edition of GTA 6 on Blinkit if your area is covered.
Redeem the code through the PlayStation Store.
Download the game ahead of time, before it unlocks in India at midnight.

body.text: Rockstar Games is releasing GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but Inc42 notes that Blinkit's listing is for PS5 only.
GTA 6 price in India on Blinkit
Blinkit is selling the PS5 Standard Edition at ₹5,999. According to Inc42, that matches the price on the PlayStation Store, so there is no visible markup for the convenience of delivery.
Dhindsa framed the move with a nod to the long wait. "It took 13 years for GTA 6 to be released," he said, adding that Blinkit was built in the meantime so the game could be delivered in minutes.

Availability is limited to select areas, not whole cities. Inc42 lists Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata and Ahmedabad. Dhindsa said more cities would be added between November 18 and 19.
If your pin code is not served yet, the PlayStation Store remains the direct route at the same ₹5,999 price for the Standard Edition.
Why Blinkit keeps chasing unusual launches

Inc42 places the GTA 6 push in a pattern. Blinkit launched a 10-minute ambulance service in parts of Gurugram in January 2025, added printouts and passport-size photo orders, and ran a "Scream for Ice Cream" discount challenge. These stunts help it stand out against Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket.

The business backing it is growing fast. Inc42 reports that in Q2 FY27, Blinkit's net order value rose 79.3% year on year to ₹20,940 Cr, and revenue grew 93.6% to ₹19,152 Cr. It posted an adjusted EBITDA profit of ₹184 Cr, against a loss of ₹156 Cr a year earlier. Its network stands at 2,751 dark stores, with Eternal expecting more than 3,500 by March 2027 and about 5,000 by March 2028.

Watch how quickly Blinkit adds cities over November 18 and 19, and whether stock holds up once the game unlocks at midnight. Also see if other quick commerce rivals try to match the offer, and whether Xbox players get a similar option. None of that is confirmed in the source, so treat it as something to track, not a promise.

faqs.q: Which cities have GTA 6 Blinkit delivery?
faqs.a: According to Inc42, GTA 6 is available in select areas of Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata and Ahmedabad. Blinkit plans to add more cities between November 18 and 19.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 price in India on Blinkit?
faqs.a: Blinkit is selling the PS5 Standard Edition of GTA 6 for ₹5,999, which Inc42 reports is the same as the PlayStation Store price.

faqs.q: Does Blinkit deliver a GTA 6 disc?
faqs.a: No. Inc42 reports that customers get a physical box containing a digital download code, which they redeem through the PlayStation Store instead of receiving a disc.

sources.title: Blinkit Brings GTA 6 To 11 Cities Ahead Of Launch
